name: plan_reads
description: Plan the reads the answer to the developer's unfinished ask will certainly need. Name a session transcript only when the ask is about what one listed session is doing, did, or said, by its option number; name a notebook search only for prior decisions, people, dates, or preferences. Plan nothing when in doubt.

session.description: The option number of the session in the list you were shown.

query.description: What to search the notebook for.

reads.description: The reads the answer will certainly need: at most one session transcript and one notebook search. Empty when none is needed.
